assessment.supported_part: The passages establish that the paper investigates four learning strategies/models and identify two of them: ModelI Base, a joint training strategy aggregating all domains with shared parameters, and ModelII, which connects large-scale unsupervised pre-trained models (BERT) to multi-domain learning.
assessment.gap: The identities and descriptions of the remaining two of the four learning strategies (Models III and IV) are not established by the supplied passages.
